notes.title: Happy Quest was updated to v1.1.0 !!!
notes.content:
Hi every one, we just updated Happy Quest, please update the game end enjoy the quest.

Fix:
- "Complete chapter" achievements were unlocked with wrong condition
- "Poverty No More!" and "Swim In Gold" achievements didn't count spent gold
- "One Shot!" achievement was unlocked with wrong condition
- A bug in conversation that prevents users to finish the conversation
- UI sounds are not played

Improvements:
- Add a visual indicator to the Power Up button
- Adjust Battle UI
- Battle sound effects

New Features:
- Add Easy mode

Easy Mode:
- You can only choose this mode at the main menu (play New Game, or overwrite a saved slot)
- HP and Power stats are increased to 140%



Cheer !!!
